description: A domain availability checker that asks each registry directly: one name, forty endings, the answer in seconds. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

endings.description: Optional list of endings to check instead of the default 40, e.g. ['com','io','ai','dk']. Without a leading dot; 'co.uk' style second-level endings work. Fewer endings answer faster. Default: com, net, org, io, ai, app, dev, co, eu, dk, de, se, no, fi, nl, be, fr, es, it, pl, pt, at, ch, uk, co.uk, shop, store, online, site, tech, xyz, me, tv, info, biz, cloud, studio, design, live, blog.

locale.description: Language of the registrar's page behind each register link: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en.

name.description: The name to check, with or without an ending: 'nordlys', 'nordlys.dk' or a pasted URL like 'https://www.nordlys.dk/about' (scheme, www, path and port are stripped; a subdomain is dropped). Letters like æ, ø, å, ä, ö, ü, ñ are allowed and converted to punycode. Spaces are removed. If an ending is given it is checked first, before the others.

suggest.description: When the .com is taken, also check four .com variants (get<name>, <name>hq, <name>app, try<name>) and return the free ones in suggestions. Default true.

name: domain_availability
title: Domain Availability Checker
